sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: On a phone, the sidebar's ▶/◀ handle stays inside what the screen shows: MusicBrainz lays its pages out like a desktop page there, and the handle sat at the right edge of the whole page, out of sight and impossible to tap.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Tests: tests/fixtures/sidebar-collapse-handle.mobile.spec.js (1); two popup-ext.spec.js checks of a Live page now wait for the frame to be set up, column-filter-modes.spec.js compares settled column widths, and a popup-mb area chain and a sticky-page-headers sidebar check wait for the page to settle (timing failures under a full run). Mutations: 2 more in scripts/mutations/sidebar-overhaul.json (1 caught, 1 recorded as untestable: a pinch-zoom), 1 in column-filter-modes.json, caught; 3 stale anchors in scripts/mutations/sticky-page-headers.json repointed, all caught again.
